cases.name: compute-unknown-tag
cases.description: A tag the compute language has no meaning for
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><compute><result><frobnicate/></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-current-outside-a-loop
cases.description: <current/> where there is nothing being walked
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><compute><result><current/></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-unbound-var
cases.description: <use> naming a binding no <let> made
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><compute><result><use name="ghost"/></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-wrong-arity

cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><compute><result><divide><int v="10"/></divide></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-choose-without-otherwise
cases.description: A choose whose branches can all miss
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><compute><result><choose><when><test><equals><field name="A"/><int v="1"/></equals></test><then><str v="one"/></then></when></choose></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-shadowing-let
cases.description: A binding that hides an outer one of the same name
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><compute><let name="x"><int v="1"/></let><let name="x"><int v="2"/></let><result><use name="x"/></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-unknown-encoding
cases.description: An encoding <encode> does not implement
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><compute><result><encode as="rot13"><field name="A"/></encode></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-missing-wrapper

cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><compute><result><each><do><current/></do></each></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-int-is-not-an-integer
cases.description: <int> holding something that is not one
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><compute><result><int v="3.5"/></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-two-results
cases.description: A second <result>, which would silently win
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><compute><result><int v="1"/></result><result><int v="2"/></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-field-out-of-scope

cases.name: compute-unknown-predicate
cases.description: A predicate that is not one, inside <test>
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><compute><result><choose><when><test><roughly><field name="A"/><int v="1"/></roughly></test><then><str v="x"/></then></when><otherwise><str v="y"/></otherwise></choose></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: mask-with-no-pattern
cases.description: <mask> with no pattern= returned the empty string, so the column came out blank
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="hello"/></sequence><sequence name="M"><compute><result><mask><field name="A"/></mask></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{M}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: mask-with-a-pattern
cases.description: The same tag with a pattern is untouched
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="hello"/></sequence><sequence name="M"><compute><result><mask pattern="xx"><field name="A"/></mask></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{M}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: mask-filter-with-no-argument
cases.description: The same fault in its filter spelling — every other bare filter is a whole transform, so this one reads like them and is not
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="hello"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A|mask}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: mask-filter-with-an-argument
cases.description: A filter with a pattern is untouched
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="hello"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A|mask:xx}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: mask-filter-with-a-bad-index
cases.description: Written as a filter the pattern reached the renderer unchecked; only the mask= attribute was parsed
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en"><sequence name="A"><gen type="text" value="hello"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{A|mask:x[1-2]}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-predicate-in-a-value-position-is-caught-before-the-run
cases.description: <greater_than> answers true or false, so it is valid only inside <test>. It used to pass check and die mid-run with a message carrying no code, no line and no file.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="C"><compute><result><greater_than><int v="2"/><int v="1"/></greater_than></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: is_digit-on-a-numeric-builtin-is-refused-not-answered-no
cases.description: <is_digit> asks about one character of TEXT; _count and _total arrive as numbers. Measured on the unfixed engine: the branch answered "no" on rows 1, 2 and 3 — rows where the count plainly is a single digit — and check said nothing at all.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><compute><result><choose><when><test><is_digit><field name="_count"/></is_digit></test><then><str v="DIGIT"/></then></when><otherwise><str v="not"/></otherwise></choose></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: encode-on-a-numeric-builtin-is-refused-before-the-run-not-during-it
cases.description: Same cause as the <is_digit> case above, different symptom. check called this valid and the run then died with "<encode>: expected a single-character string" — no file, no line, no code. <concat> around the field is the fix that works: measured 49, 50, 51, the ASCII of 1, 2 and 3.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><compute><result><encode as="ascii"><field name="_count"/></encode></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-comparison-refuses-a-str-literal-that-is-not-a-number
cases.description: The reference table declared <equals> as int|str x2, so a reader could believe two words compare. Measured: the run stopped with 'expected an integer in <equals>, got the string "ab"' — no file, no line, no code — on a config check had called valid. Both literals are wrong, so both are named.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><compute><result><choose><when><test><equals><str v="ab"/><str v="ab"/></equals></test><then><str v="EQ"/></then></when><otherwise><str v="NE"/></otherwise></choose></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>[${{V}}]</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-comparison-accepts-a-str-literal-that-spells-a-number
cases.description: The other half of the same rule, and the reason it cannot simply refuse every <str>: <equals><str v="7"/><int v="7"/></equals> is TRUE at run time. Measured [EQ]. A blanket refusal would have broken a working config.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><compute><result><choose><when><test><equals><str v="7"/><int v="7"/></equals></test><then><str v="EQ"/></then></when><otherwise><str v="NE"/></otherwise></choose></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>[${{V}}]</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: the-old-var-spelling-names-its-replacement
cases.description: <var> was renamed to <use>. Without a dedicated refusal the tag falls through to "unknown compute tag", which tells a reader their spelling is wrong and not what the right one is — and every config written before the rename hits this, including the 174 shipped pack files that had to be rewritten.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><compute><result><let name="s"><int v="7"/></let><add><var name="s"/><int v="10"/></add></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-mask-pattern-is-broken
cases.description: A <mask> pattern the mask language cannot parse — caught at check time, not left to the run
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><compute><result><mask pattern="x[1-2]"><field name="A"/></mask></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: compute-stray-sibling-beside-result
cases.description: A second value-producing tag beside <result> — one of the two would be discarded in silence
cases.config: <tdc><env count="2" seed="s"><sequence name="A"><gen type="number" value="1..9"/></sequence><sequence name="C"><compute><result><field name="A"/></result><str v="x"/></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{C}}</data></line></block></tdc>
